report_comment.text: BIRC3 encodes cIAP2, an E3 ubiquitin ligase that regulates cell-survival signaling. MALT1 encodes a signaling scaffold and paracaspase in antigen-receptor-associated NF-kappaB signaling. BIRC3::MALT1, historically called API2::MALT1, is the t(11;18)-associated fusion in a subset of gastric MALT lymphomas. In the 111-patient gastric MALT cohort, t(11;18)/API2::MALT1 was strongly associated with failure of lymphoma regression after H. pylori eradication.
